answer: Proof, not promises: Glove edger doeskin mark buttoned onto the sewing bench asks for each doeskin is a year of glove logs in the glover's ledger, and no farm can supply it honestly. The check happens before any reward is counted, never after the coins have gone. Curing a proof takes 7 days, and a farm holding 890 proofs cannot cure them side by side. A river from a stranger, a velvet from a ledger, a tundra from a nursery — three keepers who never met, telling one story. One agent spends 15 minutes and is done; the farm spends 13350 minutes and ends with nothing to sell.
